jobs.description: Career Category Information Systems Job Description Specialist Business Systems Analyst – Manufacturing Data & Analytics What You Will Do Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, you will apply manufacturing, data, and business-process expertise to translate business needs into clear product and system requirements. You will define epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, use cases, data requirements, and test scenarios that enable delivery teams to estimate, plan, and deliver with confidence. The ideal candidate will work closely with manufacturing subject matter experts, process owners, data owners, Product Owners, developers, data engineers, architects, UX designers, and QA teams to ensure manufacturing data and analytics solutions meet business, functional, quality, and compliance expectations. Roles and Responsibilities Partner closely with manufacturing SMEs, process owners, data owners, and business stakeholders to understand operational processes, decisions, pain points, and information needs. Lead workshops and interviews with SMEs to capture business rules, process variations, data definitions, exceptions, and acceptance criteria. Translate SME knowledge into clear epics, features, user stories, process maps, use cases, data mappings, and test scenarios. Capture the voice of the customer and translate business needs into product, process, data, and system requirements. Facilitate the breakdown of epics into features and sprint-sized user stories. Support product roadmaps, PI planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, and release planning. Ensure functional and non-functional requirements are documented and prioritized in product and release backlogs. Define manufacturing data, analytics, reporting, dashboard, KPI, and business-rule requirements. Document data sources, mappings, transformations, calculations, validation rules, and reconciliation criteria. Work with data engineers, architects, and analytics teams to ensure data products meet business needs. Support data-quality analysis, lineage, reconciliation, issue resolution, and business validation. Collaborate with UX/UI teams to align user journeys, process flows, requirements, and application designs. Clarify requirements, resolve gaps, and facilitate alignment when SMEs or stakeholders have conflicting needs. Validate proposed workflows, dashboards, data outputs, and application functionality with SMEs throughout design and development. Develop functional, integration, regression, and user-acceptance test scenarios. Validate delivered features against acceptance criteria, business rules, and customer expectations. Support UAT by preparing test scenarios and data, coordinating SME and business-user participation, and documenting results. Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects and work with delivery teams through resolution. Collaborate with QA teams on test automation, performance validation, and release readiness. Ensure SME feedback is incorporated throughout design, development, testing, UAT, and release preparation. Develop and deliver product demonstrations for business, SME, and technical stakeholders. Maintain accurate documentation of requirements, decisions, processes, user stories, and changes. Use Jira, Confluence, and Agile delivery tools to manage requirements, backlogs, defects, and sprint activities. Work within Agile and Scaled Agile environments to deliver incremental business value. Identify opportunities to automate manual activities and improve requirements, testing, and delivery processes. Mentor other analysts and promote consistent business-analysis standards and reusable practices. Stay current with manufacturing, data, analytics, cloud, AI, and product-delivery trends. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree and 8–13 years of experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Data, or a related field. Must-Have Skills Extensive experience in business systems analysis, product analysis, or requirements engineering. Demonstrated experience working directly with business and technical SMEs to elicit, clarify, validate, and document complex requirements. Strong workshop facilitation and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to translate specialized manufacturing and process knowledge into clear functional, data, and technical requirements. Experience writing epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, and process maps. Experience supporting product roadmaps, PI planning, backlog refinement, prioritization, and user journeys. Experience defining data, analytics, reporting, KPI, and dashboard requirements. Understanding of data mapping, validation, business rules, reconciliation, lineage, and data-quality concepts. Experience testing and validating user stories against business requirements and acceptance criteria. Experience supporting functional testing, regression testing, defect management, and UAT. Experience using Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or comparable product-delivery tools. Experience with Agile, SAFe, Scrum, DevOps, and iterative delivery practices. Strong ability to communicate complex technical, manufacturing, and data concepts in clear business terms. Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and conflict-resolution skills. Ability to work effectively with global, virtual, and cross-functional teams. Ability to quickly learn and apply new business processes, technologies, and tools. Good-to-Have Skills Experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, life sciences, manufacturing, or another regulated industry. Knowledge of manufacturing processes, systems, operational data, and analytics. Experience working with manufacturing SMEs, process owners, engineering teams, or site stakeholders. Familiarity with Databricks, data lakes, data warehouses, ETL/ELT, and enterprise data architectures. Understanding of Python, PySpark , SQL, FastAPI , APIs, and data-ingestion concepts. Familiarity with AWS cloud services and cloud-based data and analytics platforms. Understanding of modern web applications, REST APIs, UX principles, React, Angular, HTML, CSS, or JavaScript. Familiarity with CI/CD, Git, automated testing, DevOps, and software-engineering practices. Experience with monitoring and visualization tools such as Grafana, Splunk, Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent technologies. Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve requirements documentation, process analysis, testing, and business productivity. Familiarity with Generative AI, machine learning, and AI-enabled product requirements. Experience with test automation tools or frameworks. Experience supporting validated or regulated computerized systems. Preferred Certifications Scaled Agile Framework certification — preferred. Business analysis, product management, or Agile certification — preferred. AWS cloud, data, developer, or solutions architecture certification — preferred. Databricks certification — preferred. Soft Skills Excellent analytical, critical-thinking, and troubleshooting skills. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Strong facilitation, presentation, and public-speaking skills. High degree of initiative, ownership, and self-motivation. Ability to manage multiple priorities successfully. Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. Team-oriented mindset with a focus on shared outcomes. Ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across teams. Ability to build trusted relationships with SMEs, business partners, and technical teams. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global, and matrixed environment. .

jobs.description: Satellite Systems Engineer (Associate) Company: The Boeing Company Boeing Defense, Space, and Security (BDS) seeks a seeks a Satellite Systems Engineer to serve as Global Positioning System (GPS) Satellite Bus Systems Engineer to serve on the Global Positioning System (GPS) IIF program, within our Space, Intelligence & Weapon Systems (SI&WS) division located at El Segundo, CA. GPS is a satellite-based radio-navigation system owned by the United States government and operated by the United States Space Force and is the world's first global utility. GPS provides position, navigation, and timing (PNT) data to military and civilian users globally with countless applications and an unlimited number of users. Boeing has over 45 years of history in GPS, including achieving full system capability in 1995. The current Boeing team supports the US Space Force by sustaining and monitoring the health and capabilities of the 12 GPS Block IIF satellites in the GPS constellation, launched from 2010 to 2016. The Boeing GPS sustainment team also provides support to our U.S. Space Force customer with reports and expertise on all aspects of the GPS system. Sustainment efforts will continue through the life of the Block IIF satellites, with a design life expectancy to 2031 and beyond. The program currently operates under a 10-year sustainment contract, from 2022 to 2031. As GPS Satellite Bus Systems Engineer , you will be a key member of a high-performing team engaged in critical projects related to the GPS IIF satellite constellation. You will train to become a subject matter expert for satellite Bus subsystems on the GPS Block IIF satellites and for GPS performance trending and analysis. You will also work closely with the spacecraft payload and secondary payload subject matter experts and interact daily with the U.S. Space Force’s 2 Navigation Warfare Squadron personnel commanding satellites and satellite performance trending and analysis. About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
We're hiring Cyber Evaluations Engineers to build and run the evaluations that measure cyber-relevant capabilities and safeguard robustness in our models. You'll design new evals, run per-release robustness testing, and dig into data on jailbreaks and prompt bypasses to understand where our safeguards hold up and where they don't. You'll also design many of the probes that detect cyber abuse in production and help shape the overall detection architecture alongside the policy team.
Key responsibilities
Design and run capability, uplift, and safety evaluations to assess cyber-relevant risk in new models
Execute per-release safeguard-robustness testing ahead of major model launches
Analyze evaluation results and communicate findings clearly to the team and to stakeholders
Design, prototype, and tune detection probes for cyber misuse
Work with the cyber policy team to turn policy lines into a layered, robust abuse-detection architecture, and measure its precision and coverage over time
Build and maintain internal tooling used to run and score evaluations
Collaborate with policy and engineering partners to translate eval findings into safeguard improvements

Experience building or running evaluations, benchmarks, or test suites for software or ML systems, including delivering results on short, fixed timelines

Experience working onsite with government partners on testing or evaluation engagements
Experience with AI/ML evaluation frameworks
Familiarity with coordinated vulnerability disclosure practices
Experience testing pre-release or pre-deployment software or models under confidentiality constraints

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. Build enterprise-grade trade compliance models ensuring adherence to regional import/export mandates, tariff classifications, valuations, and customs policies.

Experience managing 3PLs, freight forwarders, carriers, customs operations, and fulfillment networks.

The role is working within our studio: Tripledot Games
About Tripledot Games
Tripledot Games is a leading developer and publisher of casual and puzzle games, with a strong presence in London, Warsaw, and Barcelona. The studio is responsible for multiple top 10 titles, including Woodoku, Woodoku Blast, Solitaire, and TripleTile. Our best-in-class data-driven approach spans the entire lifecycle from publishing to machine learning puzzle levels, helping us make fast, smart decisions at every stage of development.
We are also one of the largest IAA operators worldwide. Tripledot Games is a diverse and collaborative studio, home to people from over 36 nationalities. We take pride in our craftsmanship, strong focus on outcomes, and continuous improvement, building high-quality, scalable games that players around the world love.
Role Overview
As a Data Scientist in our Experimentation team, you will help deliver and improve Tripledot’s company-wide experimentation analysis platform. Working closely with Data Engineering, you will define the statistical logic and methodologies behind platform features, build prototypes in Python, and ensure the platform produces accurate, reliable results for product teams across our games portfolio.
Your initial focus will include hands-on quality assurance: running independent analyses, comparing results with platform outputs, investigating discrepancies, and validating features and metrics. This offers the opportunity to develop deep expertise in experimentation and A/B testing across a sophisticated internal platform. As the platform evolves, the role will expand into more advanced statistical and machine learning work that delivers value across the business.
Key Responsibilities
Define statistical logic, calculation methods, and detailed requirements for experimentation platform features.
Prototype statistical methodologies and analyses in Python before implementation.
Partner closely with Data Engineers as they develop and improve the experimentation platform.
Perform thorough data and feature QA by independently calculating results and comparing them with platform outputs.
Investigate discrepancies, identify root causes, and help ensure metrics and analyses are accurate and reliable.
Explore opportunities to automate QA processes and improve the efficiency and quality of validation.
Build a deep understanding of experimentation methodologies, including A/B testing, monitoring, segmentation, and analysis.
Collaborate with BI, Machine Learning, product teams, and other stakeholders to understand requests and shape effective solutions.
Contribute to future statistical, algorithmic, and machine learning initiatives as the team’s priorities evolve.
Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
3-5 years of professional experience as a Data Scientist or in a closely related role
Strong Python skills, including the ability to prototype analyses and write clear, reliable scripts.
Solid knowledge of statistics and standard statistical methodologies.
Practical understanding of experimentation and A/B testing, including how metrics and results should be calculated and validated.
Familiarity with machine learning methods and the ability to apply relevant approaches when needed.
Excellent attention to detail and a disciplined approach to repetitive or methodical QA work.
Strong problem-solving skills, with the initiative to propose creative solutions and process improvements.
Clear communication skills and the ability to explain analytical methods, results, and rationale.
Experience with experimentation platforms or high-volume digital products, such as gaming, e-commerce, or ride-hailing, would be valuable.
